summary: The change matches the spec. validate sums the snapshot stacks after the per-seat loop and throws the exact Q-1 RangeError (A-1 order holds). Both comments are rewritten word for word, and the SPEC-06 grep returns nothing (exit 1). The tests would catch broken implementations. SPEC-03 fails if the check is removed or moved before the per-seat loop (the 2**53 case would then get the total error). SPEC-04 fails under factor 9 or 11. SPEC-05 throws on a second getter read and compares exact counts. SPEC-01/02 scan every chip field and check conservation, with a 10,000-action guard. The locked TASK-1.21 file changes only the seat-3 MAX_SAFE assertion: MAX_SAFE-800 is accepted and MAX_SAFE throws the new error, per Q-2. No scratch files and no new src helpers. Both changed test files pass locally (9/9) and the gate is green. The 211 lines are over the 190 budget, but only by a warn, and the extra lines are test code. One MINOR finding: the TASK-1.21 lock was never formally unlocked or re-hashed.
